# Líneach Fire Stop — Install-only fire stopping, Ireland

Líneach Fire Stop is the fire stopping package of Lineach Construction Limited. We supply labour and certified materials and install to drawings and specifications issued by others. We do not design firestop systems, survey buildings, locate missing penetrations, or accept design responsibility.

## What we install
- Penetration sealing after M&E first-fix (pipes, cables, trays, ducts)
- Linear joint seals (head-of-wall, floor-to-wall, construction / movement joints as detailed)
- Cavity and void barriers where they appear on issued details
- BCAR handover: photo log, seal register, product evidence, construction ancillary for installation to issued details only

## What we do not do
- Design or system selection
- Surveys or find-all-penetrations duties
- Design ancillaries or professional indemnity for design
- UK Approved Document B work
- Nationwide coverage

## Locations
- Company: Lineach Construction Limited, trading as Líneach Fire Stop. Registered in Ireland, CRO 696323
- Head office / base: Ardnamullan, Clonard, Co. Meath, A83 FC42, Ireland (Enfield / Summerhill)
- Service area only: Dublin, Meath, Kildare, Wicklow and Louth
